lessons.title: Defining Abnormality, Diagnostic Systems & The Biopsychosocial Model
lessons.description: Examine the 4 D's of abnormality, the DSM-5-TR, the medical model, and Rosenhan's landmark study.

lessons.title: Anxiety, Obsessive-Compulsive & Trauma-Related Disorders
lessons.description: Understand GAD, panic attacks, specific phobias, OCD behavioral cycles, and PTSD neurobiology.

lessons.title: Depressive, Bipolar & Schizophrenia Spectrum Disorders
lessons.description: Master Major Depressive Disorder, Beck's cognitive triad, Bipolar I/II mania, and schizophrenia symptoms.

lessons.title: Evidence-Based Psychotherapies & Biomedical Treatments
lessons.description: Compare CBT, psychodynamic, client-centered therapy, psychopharmacology, and electroconvulsive therapy.
